chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu al-Jarud Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir, from al-Qasim ibn al-Walid, from a shaykh from Thumala. He said:

I visited an old woman from the tribe of Tamim who was narrating to the people. I said to her: May God have mercy on you. Narrate to me some of the virtues of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali (peace be upon him). She said: I will narrate to you while this elder — as you can see — is sleeping before me? I said to her: Who is this? She said: Abu al-Hamra', the servant of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family). So I sat by him, and when he sensed me he straightened up sitting, and said: What? I said: May God have mercy on you. Narrate to me what you saw the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) do with Ali (peace be upon him), for God will ask you about it. He said: You have come to one well-informed. As for what I saw the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) do with Ali (peace be upon him), he said to me one day: O Abu al-Hamra'!

Go and summon for me one hundred Arabs, fifty non-Arab men, thirty Coptic men, and twenty Abyssinian men. I brought them, and the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) stood and arranged the Arabs in a row, then arranged the non-Arabs in a row behind the Arabs, and arranged the Copts in a row behind the non-Arabs, and arranged the Abyssinians in a row behind the Copts. Then he stood and praised God and extolled Him, and glorified God with a glorification the like of which the creation had never heard. Then he said: O assembly of Arabs, non-Arabs, Copts, and Abyssinians! Have you affirmed the testimony that there is no god but God, alone without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger? They said: Yes. He said: O God, bear witness — he said it three times. Then on the third time he said: Have you affirmed the testimony that there is no god but God, and that I, Muhammad, am His servant and His messenger, and that Ali ibn Abi Talib is the Commander of the Faithful and the master of their affairs after me? They said: O God, yes. He said: O God, bear witness — he said it three times. Then he said to Ali (peace be upon him): O Abu al-Hasan! Go and bring me a parchment and an inkwell. Then he handed them to Ali ibn

Abi Talib and said: Write. He said: What should I write? He said: Write: 'In the name of God, the Beneficent, the Merciful. This is what the Arabs, non-Arabs, Copts, and Abyssinians have affirmed. They have affirmed the testimony that there is no god but God, and that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger, and that Ali ibn Abi Talib is the Commander of the Faithful and the master of their affairs after me.' Then he sealed the parchment and handed it to Ali (peace be upon him), and I have not seen it since. I said: May God have mercy on you. Give me more. He said: Yes. The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) came out to us on the Day of Arafah while holding the hand of Ali (peace be upon him), and said: O creation! God, Blessed and Exalted, has taken pride in you on this day to forgive you all in general. Then he turned to Ali (peace be upon him) and said to him: And He has forgiven you, O Ali, especially.

Then he (peace be upon him and his family) said: O Ali, draw near to me. He drew near to him. Then he said: The truly happy one — the fully happy one — is he who loves you and obeys you. And the truly wretched one — the utterly wretched one — is he who opposes you, bears enmity toward you, and hates you. O Ali! Whoever claims to love me yet hates you has lied. O Ali! Whoever wars against you has warred against me, and whoever wars against me has warred against God, Mighty and Majestic. O Ali! Whoever hates you has hated me, and whoever hates me has hated God. May God make his grandfather wretched and cause him to enter the Fire of Hell.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful — the title given to Ali ibn Abi Talib as the designated leader of the Muslim community after the Prophet
key_terms.بَاهَى: took pride in / boasted about — referring to God's expression of pride in the assembled believers
key_terms.خَادِمُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: servant of the Messenger of God — indicates Abu al-Hamra''s direct personal proximity to the Prophet
key_terms.وَلِيُّ أَمْرِهِمْ: master of their affair / guardian of their affairs — indicating political and religious authority
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: Day of Arafah — the ninth of Dhu al-Hijjah, the central day of the Hajj pilgrimage, a time of immense spiritual significance and communal gathering

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali ibn Abi Talib's authority in front of Arabs, non-Arabs, Copts, and Abyssinians?
ai.summary: Abu al-Hamra', a companion and servant of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), recounts two remarkable incidents demonstrating the Prophet's declaration of Ali's authority. In the first, the Prophet assembled two hundred men from four nations and had them testify to Ali's appointment as Amir al-Mu'minin, documenting it in a sealed written covenant. In the second, on the Day of Arafah during the Hajj, the Prophet publicly proclaimed that loving and obeying Ali is the mark of true happiness, while opposing him is the mark of true wretchedness — equating enmity toward Ali with enmity toward God Himself. This hadith belongs to a corpus of traditions asserting the Imamate of Ali by explicit appointment (nass) from the Prophet.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Masrur b. al-Mutawakkil (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi from his father from Muhammad b. Sinan from Abi'l Jarud Ziyad b. al-Mundhir from al-Qasim b. al-Walid from a shaykh from Thumala. He said: I visited an old lady from Tamim, who was narrating to the people. So, I said to her: May Allah have mercy on you. Narrate some of the virtues of Amir al-Mu'minin `Ali (as) to me. She said: You want me to narrate to you while this elder is sleeping right in front of you? So, I said to her: Who is this? So, she said: Abu Hamra', the servant of the Messenger of Allah (s). So, she sat by him, and when he sensed me, he awoke and sat up. So, he said: What? So, she said: May Allah have mercy on you. Narrate to me about what you have seen the Messenger of Allah (s) do with `Ali (as), for Allah will ask you about it. So, he said: You have come across an informed one. As for what I've seen the Messenger of Allah (s) do with `Ali (as), he said to me one day: O Aba'l Hamra’! Go and get me one hundred Arabs, fifty non-Arab men, thirty Coptic men, and twenty Abyssinian men. So, I brought them, so the Messenger of Allah (s) put the Arabs in a row, then put the non-Arabs in a row behind the Arabs, then put the Copts in a row behind the non-Arabs, then put the Abyssinians in a row behind the Copts. Then, he stood, praised and commended Allah, and glorified Allah in a way that had never been heard from the creatures. Then, he said: O Arabs, non-Arabs, Copts, and Abyssinians! Have you declared that there is no god but Allah, one without partners, and that Muhammad is His Servant and His Messenger? So, they said: Yes. So, he said: O Allah, bear witness. He repeated this three times, and the third time he said: Have you declared that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is His Servant and His Messenger, and that `Ali b. Abi Talib is the Commander of the Faithful and the Master of their Affair after me? So, they said: O Allah, yes. So, he said: O Allah, bear witness. He said this three times. Then, he said to `Ali (as): O Aba'l Hasan! Go and bring me a pen and paper. So, he gave them to `Ali b. Abi Talib and said: Write. So, he said: What should I write? He said: Write: “In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. This is what the Arabs, the non-Arabs, the Copts, and the Abyssinians have declared. They have declared that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is His Servant and His Messenger, and that `Ali b. Abi Talib is the Commander of the Faithful and the Master of their Affair after me.” Then, he put his seal on the paper, and he gave it to `Ali (as). I did not see it afterwards. So, I said: May Allah have mercy on you. Increase for me. So, he said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah (s) came out to us on the Day of `Arafa, while he was holding the hand of `Ali (as), so he said: O creatures! Allah is boasting that He will forgive you all today. Then, he looked to `Ali (as) and said to him: And he has forgiven you, `Ali, especially. Then, he (s) said: O `Ali! Come closer to me. So, he came closer to him. Then, he said: He who is most rightfully happy is the one who loves you and obeys you. He who is most rightfully wretched is the one who opposes you and hates you. O `Ali! Whoever wars against you wars against me, and whoever wars against me wars against Allah. O `Ali! Whoever hates you has hated me, and whoever hates me has hated Allah. Allah makes his grandfather miserable (?) and makes him enter the Fire of Hell.
